{{dablink|This page refers to the animal sometimes known as a ''gensa''. For the southern feast featuring brightly colored ribbons, see [[Genshai]].}}

'''Sand pigs''', also called ''[[gensa]]'' are smallish pigs endemic to the [[Aiel Waste]].{{ref/book|beasts|Sand pig}}

They travel in smallish herds as large as several dozen throughout most of the Waste. Their coloration is similar to sand and they are immune to most of the Waste's poisons and venoms.{{ref/book|beasts|Sand pig}}

Sand pigs are not mentioned by name in the main series or ''[[The Wheel of Time Companion]]''.
